tagline: The only office technology company you will ever need

why_choose_us.title: On site in four hours
why_choose_us.description: Not a callback window, not a ticket number. When a device goes down, a GBM technician is at your office in four hours or less — because we dispatch from Kingston, Edwardsville, Moosic, Hazleton and Williamsport, not from another state.

why_choose_us.title: Locally owned since 1969
why_choose_us.description: Fifty-seven years in the same valley, and the decisions about your account still get made here. Over 45 sales and service professionals, none of them routing you to a head office three time zones away.

why_choose_us.title: One vendor for print and IT
why_choose_us.description: The copier, the network it sits on, the security around it and the documents that come off it are all our responsibility. Nobody gets to point at the other guy.

why_choose_us.title: You can see what a page costs
why_choose_us.description: Managed print gives you real tracking of volume and cost per page across every device on the network, so print spend becomes a number you manage instead of a bill you absorb.
